result.description: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer; API creates/manages Devin sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, schedules, and enterprise admin/analytics.
result.auth_detail: v3 API: Bearer `cog_` tokens. Service user API key (org or enterprise scoped, created in Settings > Devin API) or per-user Personal Access Token. No OAuth2 for third-party apps. Legacy v1/v2 apk_ keys deprecated.
result.access_detail: No app review, listing or partner status: each customer creates own service user key or PAT in their org settings (per-account private tokens, not a gate). Signup self-serve with a Free plan; docs do not state API is restricted to paid plans, but Free is 'limited usage' and the Teams quickstart targets paid Teams orgs, so a paid plan (Pro $20, Teams $80) may be needed for real use/service users. Enterprise-scope endpoints need Enterprise (contact sales); enterprise PATs disabled by default.
result.api_notes: v3 REST at api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/* and /v3/enterprise/*; ~315 API doc pages: sessions (create/list/message/terminate/tags/insights/attachments), Devin Review, knowledge notes, playbooks, secrets, automations/schedules, users/RBAC, analytics, audit logs, billing. Terraform provider exists. Legacy v1/v2 deprecated.
result.blocker: Auth is user-created cog_ bearer token (no OAuth), plus org ID needed in URLs; plan requirement for API on Free tier unconfirmed; enterprise endpoints need Enterprise plan.

evidence.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format. Include your token in the `Authorization` header of every request:
| **Service User** (non-human) | Service User API Key | For automated integrations and CI/CD pipelines |
Go to **Settings > Devin API** in your organization and open the **Service users** tab
Devin has four self-serve plans you can sign up for directly at [app.devin.ai](https://app.devin.ai).
Personal Access Tokens (PATs) allow human users to authenticate programmatically under their own identity.
Set up the official Devin MCP server so external AI tools can manage sessions, playbooks, knowledge, and repository docs.
For cross-organization management — analytics, audit logs, user management, billing, and infrastructure. Available to enterprise customers.
